# ui::KeyFrameAnimation

Header: `winui/ui/Animation.hpp`.

A key frame animation of one property. The frames play from the property's current value. `duration` 0 is the last key time.

Example: 
```cpp
auto element = std::make_unique<ui::RectangleControl>();
element->start_animation(ui::AnimatedProperty::ScaleX,
                         ui::KeyFrameAnimation{.key_frames   = {ui::KeyFrame::linear(150ms, 1.2f),
                                                                ui::KeyFrame::linear(300ms, 1.0f)},
                                               .repeat_count = 2.0});
```

| Field | Type | Default | |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `key_frames` | `std::vector<KeyFrame>` |  | The frames, sorted by time; the first segment starts at the property's current value. |
| `duration` | `Duration` |  | Iteration length; 0 uses the last key time. |
| `repeat_count` | `double` | `1.0` | Iterations to run; infinity repeats forever. |
| `fill` | `FillBehavior` | `FillBehavior::HoldEnd` | What the property shows once the animation finishes. |
| `on_completed` | `Callback<void()>` |  | Fires once when the animation finishes. |
